Apple TV+ is currently heating up with several new shows and a strong lineup, with another new title set to join soon. The British comedy "Small Prophets" will premiere next week and has already earned a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's the trailer.

"Small Prophets" will premiere on Apple TV+ on October 7, and has already been beloved by audiences and critics before its debut.

Last month, Apple TV+ announced an unusual arrangement: acquiring the streaming rights to an existing series from another network.

The British comedy "Small Prophets" aired earlier this year in the UK to great acclaim, scoring strong ratings on the BBC and earning a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Now Apple is bringing this critically acclaimed series to global audiences.

"Small Prophets" will premiere on Apple TV+ on October 7 (Wednesday), with the first two episodes available immediately, followed by weekly releases until the finale on November 4.

Apple today unveiled the trailer for "Small Prophets," giving a glimpse of what the series has in store. Here's a synopsis of the show, followed by the trailer:

"Small Prophets" is created, written, and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who is also the creator of "Detectorists" and has appeared in the UK version of "The Office" and "Pirates of the Caribbean."

Note: "Small Prophets" will be available on Apple TV+ globally, but UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 to watch it.

Currently airing comedies on Apple TV+ include "Brothers" starring Matthew McConaughey, as well as the fourth season of "Ted Lasso." Owen Wilson's popular series "Stick" is also set to return soon.

Apple TV+ costs $14.99 per month, or you can enjoy a discounted bundle through the Apple One package.
